owned_invariants: An assessment is the host's finding on one attempt: whether it is accepted, the residual the next prompt may show, and a measure where smaller is better.
unread is the assessment of a reply the host cannot read: not accepted, the reason as the residual under the key malformed, and no measure.
row is one line of a trail: the attempt's number, its measure and its residual.

limit is the task's max_attempts when it is an exact integer from 1 to the ceiling, and the default when the task names none. Any other value is an error that says whether the type or the range is wrong.
with_residual writes the prompt, a new line, the words Host residual and the residual as canonical JSON.
Fuel only goes down. draw takes one unit and records the amount left; when none is left it takes nothing, records nothing and says so. trace is the starting amount and the amount after each draw.
boundaries: What a residual may say is decided by the domain that builds it. This file carries it and does not inspect it.
Fuel counts questions put to the model. It is not a token or cost budget.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.

basis.G1: Module header declares AuthorityEffect None and the contract URN; public items match this contract and code/rust/pfp_operads/README.md. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond the README and docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.

basis.G3: limit distinguishes a value that is not an exact integer from one out of range, each with its own sentence. draw on spent fuel returns false. No unwrap, expect or index. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
